meta_title: Aporta · Housing and city guide for Benjamin Constant
meta_description: Houses, apartments, studios, rooms and hotels in Benjamin Constant, with direct WhatsApp contact with the owner, plus a city guide for new arrivals.
footer_tagline: Where to live and what to do in Benjamin Constant, straight from the people who own the place.
not_found_description: The address changed or was mistyped. Go back home and search from there.
error_description: We could not load this page right now. Try again in a moment.
http_network_error: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
http_unexpected_error: The server answered with an unexpected error. Try again in a moment.
http_invalid_response: The server answered in a format we did not expect. Try again in a moment.
hero_title: Find a place to live in Benjamin Constant
hero_lead: Houses, studios, rooms and hotels, straight from the owner on WhatsApp. For anyone arriving to study, work or see the city.
hero_cta_owner: I have a place to list
hero_scene_label: Wooden houses over the river, seen from the bank
trust_title: No lost groups, no price surprises
trust_direct_text: One tap opens the WhatsApp chat with the listing name already written. There is no middleman and no sign-up for people searching.
trust_verified_title: Verified owner and an up-to-date ad
trust_verified_text: Every ad shows when it was last updated. A stale ad often means the place is already rented, and we keep that in plain sight.
trust_clear_text: Water, electricity and internet are either in the price or not, and the card says so before you open the ad. Anything not included shows as "paid by you".
guide_band_text: Where to eat, where to drink, what is on this weekend, and where the bank, pharmacy and port are. Includes the boi-bumbá festival.
owner_band_title: Graduated and left a place empty?
owner_band_text: List the house or studio in a few minutes and talk to people searching, without relying on WhatsApp groups.
listings_page_description: Filter by price, neighborhood and period and talk straight to the owner.
listings_empty_description: Remove a filter or clear the search to see available listings.
whatsapp_message: Hello! I saw the listing "{title}" ({neighborhood}) on Aporta and I am interested. Is it still available?
guide_page_description: Where to eat, drink, what is on and the useful services in Benjamin Constant.
guide_lead: A few places, chosen on purpose, for people who just arrived.
guide_empty_title: No places in this tab yet
guide_empty_description: We are filling in the guide little by little. Check the other tabs in the meantime.
guide_whatsapp_message: Hello! I saw {name} in the Aporta guide.
owner_page_description: Register your house, studio, room or hotel in a few steps and talk to people searching.
owner_lead: Six short steps. What you write is saved on this device, so you can leave to take the photos and come back later.
tip_photo_facade: The front of the house, head on and in daylight.
tip_photo_bedroom: The whole bedroom, not just the bed.
tip_photo_bathroom: The bathroom, with the shower in view.
tip_photo_light: Open the windows: photos in natural light build more trust.
tip_values_included: Tick what is already in the rent: water, electricity and internet.
tip_values_honest: A clear price saves wasted chats: people compare by price.
field_address_hint: Only shown once a visitor opens the listing.
field_monthly_hint: Numbers only. Hotels: the equivalent of one month.
field_daily_hint: Fill in if you rent by the day.
field_included: What is included in the rent
field_minimum_hint: A semester is usually 4 to 6 months.
field_rules_hint: One per line: pets, visitors, quiet hours, schedule.
field_whatsapp_hint: With area code, numbers only. This is where chats arrive.
owner_ready_text: "{title}" was sent and is under review. Once the team approves it, the listing shows up for people searching. The draft on this device was deleted.
auth_sign_in_page_description: Sign in to your Aporta account to list your property.
auth_sign_in_lead: Use the email and password you registered with.
auth_sign_up_page_description: Create your owner account on Aporta to list your property.
auth_sign_up_lead: With an account you list your property and talk directly to people looking for a place.
auth_field_password_hint: 8 to 32 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
auth_error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with it or use another email.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
auth_error_rate_limited_wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
auth_error_unavailable: We could not reach the server right now. Try again in a moment.
auth_error_created_not_signed_in: Your account was created, but we could not sign you in right now. Sign in with your email and password.
photos_step_lead: Pick the photos of the property and say what each one shows. A listing with the facade, bedroom, bathroom and kitchen builds more trust.
photos_step_unsaved: Photos are not saved on this device like the rest of the form: if you leave the page, pick them again.
photos_empty: No photos chosen. You can list without photos, but people want to see the place.
photos_notice_limit: Only {max} photos fit. The ones over the limit were left out.
photos_notice_type: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF images. Anything else was left out.
photos_notice_duplicated: That photo is already on the list.
upload_part_no_etag: The file server did not confirm the upload of a part of the photo.
upload_part_network: Network failure while uploading the photo
upload_no_urls: The file server did not allow the upload of the remaining parts.
owner_photos_sending: Uploading the photos. Do not close this page.
owner_photos_failed: Your listing is already under review, but not all photos went up. Try again, or add them later in My listings.
owner_error_price_invalid: The monthly rent is not valid.
owner_error_neighborhood_not_found: That neighborhood is not in the city list. Choose another.
owner_error_photos_limit: The listing is already at its photo limit.
owner_error_photo_duplicated: One of these photos is already on the listing.
owner_error_photo_file: We could not find one of the uploaded photos. Choose it again.
owner_error_not_found: This listing does not exist, or it is not on your account.
owner_error_forbidden: This account cannot list properties. Sign in with an owner account.
owner_error_rate_limited: Too many submissions in a short time. Try again later.
owner_error_unavailable: We could not reach the server right now. Your form is still saved on this device; try again shortly.
owner_listings_page_description: The listings on your Aporta account, with the status of each one.
owner_listings_lead: See where each listing stands, edit its details or take it down.
owner_listings_empty_text: Add your property. The team reviews it and, once approved, it shows up for people searching.
owner_listings_archive_text: The listing comes down and stops showing for people searching. This cannot be undone from here.
owner_edit_page_description: Change the details and photos of your listing.

match.countExact=0, countPlural=*: The listing has no photos yet (up to {max}). For now you can only add: photos already uploaded stay on the listing.
match.countExact=*, countPlural=one: The listing has 1 photo (up to {max}). For now you can only add: photos already uploaded stay on the listing.
match.countExact=*, countPlural=*: The listing has {count} of {max} photos. For now you can only add: photos already uploaded stay on the listing.

label_reason_not_available: Already rented or the owner does not reply
label_reason_fake_photos: The photos are of another place
label_reason_wrong_info: Price, address or rules differ from the listing
review_note_resubmit_list: Edit the listing and save: it goes back to review.
review_note_resubmit_edit: Make the change and save: saving sends the listing back to the team for review.
owner_edit_resubmitted: Changes saved. The listing is back in review.
report_text: Tell us what is wrong with "{title}". We do not ask for your name, and the team will look at it.
report_details_hint: What happened? Do not include your phone number or personal data.
report_thanks_text: Thank you for letting us know. The Aporta team will look at the listing. If you think it is a scam, do not send money in advance.
report_error_gone: This listing is no longer online. There is no need to report it.
report_error_details: The details are over the 500 character limit.
report_error_unavailable: We cannot reach the server right now. Try again in a moment.
staff_listings_page_description: New and edited listings waiting for the team to decide.
staff_listings_lead: Open a listing to check photos and details, then approve, refuse with a reason or archive.
staff_listings_empty_pending_text: When an owner sends or resends a listing, it shows up here.
staff_listings_empty_draft_text: Refused listings stay here until the owner fixes and resends them.
staff_listings_empty_published_text: Approved listings appear here and on the public storefront.
staff_listings_empty_archived_text: Listings taken offline, by the owner or the team, appear here.
staff_detail_photos_none: The owner has not sent photos yet. The image above is only a drawing of the property type.
staff_detail_owner_none: This listing has no linked account (created before accounts existed). Name given: {name}.
staff_state_pending: This listing is waiting for the team to decide.
staff_state_draft: Sent back to the owner. When they fix it and save, it returns to the review queue.
staff_state_published: This listing is online on the storefront.
staff_state_archived: This listing was archived and is not on the storefront.
staff_refuse_text: The listing goes back to the owner as a draft, with the reason. When they fix it and save, it returns to this queue.
staff_refuse_hint: The owner will read this. Say what to change, from 3 to 500 characters.
staff_archive_text: The listing goes offline and leaves the storefront. There is no permanent deletion: it stays archived.
staff_outcome_approved: Listing approved. It is already on the storefront.
staff_outcome_refused: Listing refused. The owner sees the reason in My listings.
staff_seal_hint: The seal belongs to the owner account and applies to all their listings. Grant it after checking who they are.
staff_seal_granted: Owner verified. The seal now shows on their listings.
staff_seal_removed: Verification removed. The seal is gone from their listings.
staff_reports_lead: Open the reported listing, check it and record what the team decided.
staff_reports_no_details: The visitor did not write any details.
staff_reports_empty_open_text: When a visitor reports a listing, it shows up here.
staff_reports_empty_resolved_text: Reports the team closes are recorded here, with the note.
staff_resolve_text: Record what the team found about "{title}". The note is kept with the report.
staff_resolve_hint: For example: listing archived, or report unfounded. From 3 to 500 characters.
staff_error_not_pending: This listing is no longer in review. Someone may have decided first.
staff_error_owner_not_verifiable: This account cannot receive the verification seal.
staff_error_unavailable: We cannot reach the server right now. Try again in a moment.
staff_search_empty_text: Nothing for "{q}" in this status. Try another part of the title, or another queue status.
listings_page_missing_description: The search has fewer pages than this. Go back to the start of the list.

match.totalExact=0, totalPlural=*: No places in this area. Move or zoom out the map to see more.
match.totalExact=*, totalPlural=one: The map shows the only place in this area.
match.totalExact=*, totalPlural=*: The map shows {shown} of {total} places in this area. Zoom in to see them all.

map_pins_empty: No places in this area. Move the map or zoom out to see more.
map_pins_error: Could not load the places on the map.
map_pins_rate_limited: Too many map requests. Wait a moment and try again.
map_pins_rate_limited_wait: Too many map requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
